sentences.text:
Ranjit Ghora & Anr vs Unknown on 18 September, 2023
18.09.2023 C.R.M. (A) 3723 of 2023
 Ml. 116
Court No. 29
 Nkb

In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of  the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Bagnan Police  Station Case No. 591 of 2022 dated 06.11.2022 under Sections  498A/306/406/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3  & 4 of the DP Act (corresponding to G.R. case no. 2645 of 2022).

And  In the matter of: Ranjit Ghora & Anr.
 ....petitioners.
Mr. Soumya Basu Roy Chowdhuri  ...for the petitioners.

Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji, P.P.
 Mr. Partha Pratim Das  Ms. Eshita Dutta  ...for the State.

1. 
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. Admittedly, the deceased has committed suicide.
The present petitioners are stated to be brother-in-law and mother-in-law of the deceased.
The allegation regarding harassment and torture against the present petitioners are at the fringe.
There is nothing on record to show the immediate cause of commission of suicide by the deceased.
The husband of the deceased is stated to be on regular bail.

3. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioners, nature of allegation and completion of investigation, it is directed that the petitioner shall surrender before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Uluberia, Howrah in G.R.
Case No. 2645 of 2022 within 15 days from today.

5. The application being CRM (A) 3723 of 2023 is disposed of.
